Sources: FY2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000021344-25-000011) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001558370-25-003056, ownership as of March 3, 2025). James Quincey (Chairman and CEO) beneficially owns 4,099,518 shares, less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null; the figure includes 3,704,229 shares under options exercisable by May 2, 2025 and excludes 30,582 cash-settled share units. 5% HOLDERS: Berkshire's 9.29% reflects what it told the company as of December 31, 2024; Vanguard's and BlackRock's rest on Schedule 13G/As reporting holdings at the end of 2023, and the proxy computes all three percentages on the assumption the holders still owned those shares on March 3, 2025 (proxy footnote 4). The proxy's 5% table and directors' table are separate; none overlap. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line is dividends to Coca-Cola shareowners ($8,359m, matching the equity statement); $28m of dividends paid to noncontrolling interests is a separate line and excluded. GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K's own United States / International geographic data; the operating segments are not used.
